baseline.backend: CPU SSE4.2 + BMI2; no AVX, AVX2, FMA, F16C, OpenMP, RPC, dynamic backends, OpenSSL or subprocess
driver_requirements: Windows x64 CPU with SSE4.2 and BMI2; GPU not required

avx2.backend: CPU SSE4.2 + BMI2 + AVX + AVX2 + FMA + F16C; no native tuning, OpenMP, RPC, dynamic backends, OpenSSL or subprocess
driver_requirements: Windows x64 CPU with SSE4.2, BMI2, AVX, AVX2, FMA and F16C; OS XSAVE with XMM/YMM state enabled; GPU not required

vulkan.backend: Vulkan GPU full offload + CPU SSE4.2/BMI2/AVX/AVX2/FMA/F16C fallback; no native tuning, OpenMP, RPC, dynamic backends, OpenSSL or subprocess
driver_requirements: Windows x64 CPU with SSE4.2, BMI2, AVX, AVX2, FMA and F16C; OS XSAVE with XMM/YMM state enabled; Vulkan 1.2 driver optional, CPU fallback at AVX2

models: not included; explicit read-only bindings required
